purpose: Teach: 放浪/分断/改憲/直撃/哀れ/中高年/棄却/斬り

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は放浪生活をしていたと、警察、把握ですね
lines.en: According to our investigation, the suspect was living a transient life.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Calm opening on the subject. Steady pace, like reading from a report but with underlying care. No rush.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の分断を防ぐ活動も行います
lines.en: The police department also works to prevent division within the community.
lines.style: Formal, bureaucratic tone. Slight emphasis on the institutional 'we'—speaking on behalf of the force. Even delivery, like an official statement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、改憲論議とは関係ないと、警察、明示されたんですね
lines.en: So the department has made clear this case isn't connected to constitutional debate?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing but respectful. Slight rise at the end showing genuine curiosity, not challenge. Leaning forward slightly in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、台風直撃の被害現場で捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently conducting the investigation at the typhoon damage site.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional. Grounded in the present moment. No emotion in the delivery—just fact. The weight sits underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、哀れな被害者を救援されたんですね
lines.en: And the department was able to provide relief to the victims affected by this.
lines.style: Gentle reflection. Slower pace on 'relief'—acknowledging the human cost. Quiet respect in the tone. Not proud, just stating what was done.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中高年の被害者支援に努めております
lines.en: We're making efforts to support the middle-aged victims in particular.
lines.style: Formal but grounded. Steady, bureaucratic tone. The words feel prepared but sincere. Even rhythm, showing institutional commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、裁判所の棄却判決を警察、受け止めましたね
lines.en: And the department accepted the court's dismissal ruling in this matter.
lines.style: Measured acceptance. Slight pause before 'dismissal'—acknowledging the weight of the decision. Quiet dignity. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、刀での斬り合い事件を捜査いたしました
lines.style: Precise, almost understated. Close delivery—like sharing something that required real work. Brief, controlled. The gravity sits in the silence after.
